animations.name: strong kick
animations.prompt: Fixed full-body 16-bit pixel art fighting-game side view, facing RIGHT. Use the supplied first and last poses exactly, preserving identity, outfit, footwear, pixel art, scale and ground baseline. One powerful strong kick from standing guard to full extension. Drop smoothly into an acrobatic hand-planted high kick: shift weight onto the supporting foot, dip the torso down to plant the near palm firmly on the ground baseline beside the foot, raise the other arm behind the back, and whip the kicking leg steeply upward-right into the exact final pose. Preparation occupies roughly the first third; the kick accelerates smoothly and reaches maximum extension cleanly at the final frame. Keep the ground contact anchored on the ground baseline; end exactly on the supplied impact pose. Locked camera, no zoom, no pan, no extra props, no motion trails or effects.
